query_text: What is the molecular weight of human albumin?

ground_truth.answer: Human serum albumin (ALB, P02768) has a molecular weight of approximately 66.5 kDa (66,478 Da).

query_text: Which kinases phosphorylate ERK1/2 at their activation loop?

ground_truth.answer: ERK1/2 are phosphorylated by MEK1 (MAP2K1) and MEK2 (MAP2K2) at Thr202/Tyr204 (ERK1) and Thr185/Tyr187 (ERK2) within the activation loop.
